summary_en: This study tests adding inotuzumab ozogamicin (InO) to a treatment plan with dasatinib and other anti-cancer drugs for newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Treatment is given in 28-day courses, with the first phase lasting 60 days, and 84 days of maintenance treatment follow if complete molecular remission has not been reached. The study looks at whether adding InO leads to quicker complete molecular remission, meaning no detectable disease on very sensitive tests; the formal outcome measure is not stated. It is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa agregar inotuzumab ozogamicina (InO) a un plan de tratamiento con dasatinib y otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, para leucemia linfoblástica aguda Filadelfia positiva recién diagnosticada. El tratamiento se administra en ciclos de 28 días; la primera fase dura 60 días, y si no se alcanza la remisión molecular completa, siguen 84 días de tratamiento de mantenimiento. El estudio busca saber si agregar InO lleva a una remisión molecular completa más rápida, es decir, sin enfermedad detectable con pruebas muy sensibles; la medida de resultado formal no se indica. Es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed, untreated Ph+ B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
CD22 expression on at least 20% of blasts
At least 20% lymphoblasts in bone marrow, with BCR-ABL1 shown by FISH or PCR
not_for: Active leukemia in the central nervous system
Prior therapy for ALL, apart from limited steroids, hydroxyurea, or one intrathecal dose
Current or chronic hepatitis B or C, or HIV unless viral load is undetectable
Chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, or suspected alcohol abuse
Uncontrolled cardiac disease or QTcF above 500 msec
